title: Neon Glasshouse
description: A dreamy UK dance-pop ride at 142 BPM built around a glassy square-wave arpeggio that drifts up and down the octaves. A driving four-on-the-floor 707 groove and rolling sub-bass leave an open pocket for a rap cadence, climbing to two bright peaks with a hazy, pad-soaked valley between them.
code:
setcpm(142/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.42).lpf(900).delay(".4:.1875:.4").room(0.2),
    s("hh(3,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.45).cut(1)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(1.05),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.5).cut(1),

    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("square").decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.5).lpf(700)
  )],
  [32, stack(

    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("square").decay(0.3).sustain(0.2).gain(0.55).lpf(1100),
    n("<0 ~ 3 ~>").scale("C4:minor").s("triangle").attack(0.3).sustain(0.6).release(0.4).gain(0.4).lpf(1400)

    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [g2,bb2,d3] [f2,ab2,c3]>").s("triangle").attack(0.4).sustain(0.7).release(0.6).gain(0.45).lpf(1600).room(0.4),
    s("hh(3,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.4).cut(1)

    n("0 2 4 7 4 7 9 11").scale("C5:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.5).lpf(3000).delay(".4:.1875:.5").room(0.25).every(4, x => x.add(note(12))),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("square").decay(0.3).sustain(0.25).gain(0.58).lpf(1300),
    n("<0 3 5 3>").scale("C4:minor").s("triangle").attack(0.2).sustain(0.6).release(0.4).gain(0.42).lpf(1800)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(1.1),
